build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a container, floor, and ball physics world
create_container_with_add_container: create a container shape in the physics world using vt.add_container with polygon vertices
add_floor_with_add_box: add a floor box to the physics scene using vt.add_box with width and height
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene using C.add with scaled radius and center coordinates
set_task_goal_with_update_task: set the task goal by calling C.update_task to require the ball touching the floor
